The app

The full prototype, fully inlined: GEL styles, Westpac font, logos, the rendered dragon and all four personas. Pick who you are demoing.

State (XP, coins, wardrobe) is saved per persona in this browser. The AR camera needs a secure page; if the camera is blocked, the app falls back to the drawn tabletop.

Infrastructure

The dragon is a picture of your credit score's trajectory. It reads Westpac's own transaction data, finds the habits that move an Australian credit score, and gives one action at a time. Everything below is what makes that run.

Product rules the code enforces

  1. No brand the customer does not already pay. Naming their own providers is their data. Recommending others is promotion.
  2. The AI never claims a saving. A finding is potential until a transaction shows it.
  3. The score is ground truth. Forecasts are a range with a stated assumption.
  4. Goals fill themselves from data, never from a button.
  5. No dashes in copy. The audit fails the build if one returns.

Stack

Web: HTML + Tailwind 4 + Westpac GEL, no framework · Tools: Node, sharp, obj2gltf, three.js, playwright-core (system Edge) · AI: Python + Gemini / OpenAI · iOS: SwiftUI, ARKit, RealityKit
